projects.title: PondGuard
projects.description: Built a camera-based bird-detection system using YOLO11. The software captures detection events and triggers sprinklers and a red-beam deterrent around ponds.
projects.role: Owned the complete software implementation; a teammate handled the hardware.
projects.imageAlt: Temporary preview image for the PondGuard monitoring system

projects.title: Placestar
projects.description: Developed the backend for a university placement and examination platform with Wi-Fi–restricted access and single-session controls.
projects.role: Led a four-engineer backend team, designing the architecture, MySQL database, REST APIs, JWT authentication, and role-based access controls.
projects.result: Supported a live examination with 100+ students.
projects.imageAlt: Temporary preview image for the Placestar university platform

projects.title: Droplify
projects.description: Built a price-tracking application that collects product data from Flipkart, Amazon, Meesho, and Myntra, presents price analytics, and sends email alerts when prices drop.
projects.role: Built the application independently, including the Flask backend, SQLite database, scraping with Beautiful Soup and Selenium, analytics, and email alerts.
projects.imageAlt: Temporary preview image for the Droplify price-tracking platform

projects.title: AMC Connect
projects.description: Built a civic complaint platform that validates GPS data and screens complaint images using computer vision before submission, with live status tracking for citizens and officials.
projects.role: Developed the FastAPI backend, image-screening model, and LLM integration for automatically generated complaint descriptions.
projects.imageAlt: Temporary preview image for the AMC Connect civic platform

projects.title: ClubSphere
projects.description: Built a platform for managing multiple university clubs, including memberships, roles, events, attendance, and approval workflows.
projects.role: Led backend architecture, PostgreSQL database design, REST APIs, and JWT authentication using Node.js and Express.
projects.result: Piloted with clubs at CHARUSAT University.
projects.imageAlt: Temporary preview image for the ClubSphere management platform

projects.title: Worker Location Management
projects.description: Developed workforce-monitoring software in ThingsBoard, using nRF tag signal data and geofencing rules to monitor zones and inactivity.
projects.role: Owned the ThingsBoard configuration, geofencing rules, and dashboard, email, and on-device alert logic.
projects.result: Validated monitoring rules using RSSI signal data.
projects.imageAlt: Temporary preview image for the Worker Location Management system

about: I’m Krish Lalani, a software developer focused on Python backends and computer vision. I build REST APIs with Python and Node.js, and develop detection and image-processing pipelines with YOLO and OpenCV.

At Microble Technologies, I work on industrial inspection systems, from dataset preparation to model deployment. Previously, I led a four-engineer backend team on Placestar, building APIs, database schemas, and access controls for a platform tested with 100+ students.
